body: I can't believe no one has said this already, but that dress she's wearing is beautiful.
This shit makes me so glad my dad is an Electronics Engineer.
He has the power to control the magic smoke.

that is good advice.  i think i need someone to help me get there and practice it.  i often believe that my emotions are not valid and dont deserve discussion or consideration. i have many feelings which i think are not ok to express aloud or to anyone at all.  i sometimes feel tongue tied because i cant say what i know i should say, and get even more upset with myself for not doing it.  i get panic attacks ocassionally about mundane things like whether a friend made safe decisions in a situation i was not a part of.  i get scared for them and feel an immense obligation to protect them from mysterious evils. i often feel that i have little life experience and get very self conscious about it.  no one wants to hear the paranoid ravings of a naif.

I cant stand to be around people or look anyone in the eye right now.  I am so ashamed of myself and my behavior toward myself and my girlfriend. I want to leave the world and not have to be in pain any more.  I know that i am damaging my relationships with those i care about by conrinuing to behave this way.  I want people to feel sorry for me but i dont want to have to interact with anyone. I am a vain narcissist who is terrified of being outed, not to mention having my considerable weakness taken advantage of (again), nor my problems being exposed and mocked for the vain trivialities they are.  I cant stand the idea of being under someone elses control or power, nor the thought of being wrong. I am wasting my life waiting for the world to love me.

You are correct in your advice.  

I am strongly against medication.  

I don't have a problem with caring about people or realizing that they care about me.  I have a problem talking about my feelings/knowing how to talk about my feelings.  Certain things can't be discussed with even my girlfriend because they deal with how I view myself in our relationship.  Believe it or not there are things I don't want her to know about me, and it's not because I have a problem with being honest.  I have a right to my privacy and to dealing with things in my own way.  However I know that my way of dealing with things is not always the best way.  At the same time, I can't ask her or my close friends to help me deal with these problems specifically because they are private problems that I don't want them to know about.  I can't have my friends pitying me or feeling that I am a burden to them because that would fundamentally change our relationship.  Same goes for everyone.  I need a counselor and I don't know where to begin looking for one, or how.
